scope: Fresh predeclared paired Native demonstrations, not random generalization. Independent task evaluation, legacy v1 precision and quality are separate; a v1 cut-position metric may exceed its frozen benchmark while the task succeeds. Complete operation metadata recorded before launch; analysis is read-only. No calibration or force convergence established.

pairs.scope: Identical compiled settings with measured feedback. Resolved commands can diverge under coupled material/robot dynamics; measured tracking is reported per arm. This is not an identical-pose replay.
